correctness.rationale: Uniform directional density c_d sin^(d-2)(θ), tangent-line threshold θ≤arccos(a/r)+arccos(a/s), and independent normalized volume radial densities establish the exact two-radius cap identity. Quantile coupling makes a/R_a strictly increasing in a, so b_d strictly declines. For odd d, each H_d is a rational cosine polynomial; moment integrals reduce by z=r²-a² to finite binomial expressions with at most √(1-a²), so independent squared moments are rational. Exact b3,b5 formulae and special values verified by separately derived symbolic moments. Uniform small-cap and coupled radial limits give κ_d; boundaries a→0 and a→1 and tangencies handled. Finite checks do not substitute for universal derivation.
